description: The clip view of an arrangement's MIDI clip: a strip with its switch and name that rolls the view up, then Clip (start, end), Loop (switch, position, length, ÷2, ×2, Dupl. Loop) and Notes (transpose, invert, reverse, legato, ×2, ÷2, humanize, velocity ramps) boxes, the last two foldable, beside its piano roll (Draw, Fold, the loop brace on the ruler, keys, grid, a velocity or chance lane). Notes are drawn a grid step at a time.
name: midi-clip-panel
